landing.headline: Bring your school to Techlympics
landing.subheadline: Register as a team manager to enrol your students in Malaysia's premier technology competition. Free to join — open to all schools and institutions.

steps.title: Create your account
steps.desc: Sign up with Google or your email. Takes less than a minute.

steps.title: Set up your contingent
steps.desc: Select your school or institution and complete your profile.

steps.title: Register participants
steps.desc: Add your students and enrol them in the competitions you choose.

landing.mappingDescription: Complete pathway to national level — explore all clusters, competitions, and official participation categories of Techlympics 2026.
